text: Treasury holds about $950B in the TGA while long-end off-the-run buybacks rise from $2B to at least $4B per operation. TGA funds are available for purchases; allocation and timing remain unspecified.

meta.note: Funding may use TGA cash, short-term issuance, or both; no allocation is specified.

text: U.S.-Canada negotiations remain without agreement. New U.S. 50% tariffs cover about $20B of Canadian goods, while Canada states reciprocal tariffs will apply. Each government identifies changes by the other side as incompatible with the negotiated terms.

meta.note: Accounts conflict over which side altered terms; the disagreement remains unresolved.
